WITH sm AS (
  SELECT CAST(substr(month,1,4) AS INT) AS anio, month,
         total_sm_spend, enablement_spend, software_tools, freelance
  FROM mart.sm_monthly WHERE month >= '2022-03'
), alt AS (
  SELECT CAST(substr(month,1,4) AS INT) AS anio, SUM(new_customers) AS altas
  FROM mart.monthly_metrics WHERE month >= '2022-03' GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT sm.anio,
  ROUND(SUM(sm.total_sm_spend),3) AS sm_total,
  ROUND(SUM(sm.enablement_spend),3) AS habilitacion,
  ROUND(SUM(sm.software_tools),3) AS software_tools,
  ROUND(SUM(sm.freelance),3) AS freelance,
  ROUND(SUM(sm.enablement_spend)/SUM(sm.total_sm_spend),4) AS share_habilitacion,
  alt.altas,
  ROUND(SUM(sm.total_sm_spend)/alt.altas,4) AS sm_por_alta_con_habilitacion,
  ROUND((SUM(sm.total_sm_spend)-SUM(sm.enablement_spend))/alt.altas,4) AS sm_por_alta_sin_habilitacion
FROM sm JOIN alt ON alt.anio = sm.anio
GROUP BY sm.anio, alt.altas ORDER BY sm.anio

WITH r AS (
  SELECT 'paid_media' AS rubro, month, paid_media AS v FROM mart.sm_monthly
  UNION ALL SELECT 'publicidad_no_web', month, publicidad_no_web FROM mart.sm_monthly

WITH sm AS (
  SELECT CAST(substr(month,1,4) AS INT) AS anio, month,
         total_sm_spend, enablement_spend, software_tools, freelance
  FROM mart.sm_monthly WHERE month >= '2022-03'
), alt AS (
  SELECT CAST(substr(month,1,4) AS INT) AS anio, SUM(new_customers) AS altas
  FROM mart.monthly_metrics WHERE month >= '2022-03' GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT sm.anio,
  ROUND(SUM(sm.total_sm_spend),3) AS sm_total,
  ROUND(SUM(sm.enablement_spend),3) AS habilitacion,
  ROUND(SUM(sm.software_tools),3) AS software_tools,
  ROUND(SUM(sm.freelance),3) AS freelance,
  ROUND(SUM(sm.enablement_spend)/SUM(sm.total_sm_spend),4) AS share_habilitacion,
  alt.altas,
  ROUND(SUM(sm.total_sm_spend)/alt.altas,4) AS sm_por_alta_con_habilitacion,
  ROUND((SUM(sm.total_sm_spend)-SUM(sm.enablement_spend))/alt.altas,4) AS sm_por_alta_sin_habilitacion
FROM sm JOIN alt ON alt.anio = sm.anio
GROUP BY sm.anio, alt.altas ORDER BY sm.anio

WITH r AS (
  SELECT 'paid_media' AS rubro, month, paid_media AS v FROM mart.sm_monthly
  UNION ALL SELECT 'publicidad_no_web', month, publicidad_no_web FROM mart.sm_monthly
  UNION ALL SELECT 'team', month, team FROM mart.sm_monthly
  UNION ALL SELECT 'payroll_expenses', month, payroll_expenses FROM mart.sm_monthly

  UNION ALL SELECT 'software_tools', month, software_tools FROM mart.sm_monthly
  UNION ALL SELECT 'freelance', month, freelance FROM mart.sm_monthly
)
SELECT rubro,
  COUNT(*) AS meses_en_archivo,

  SUM(CASE WHEN v > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS meses_positivos,
  SUM(CASE WHEN v = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS meses_en_cero,
  SUM(CASE WHEN v < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS meses_negativos,

params.sql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT month, total_sm_spend AS tot, 'team' AS rubro, team AS v FROM mart.sm_monthly
  UNION ALL SELECT month, total_sm_spend, 'paid_media', paid_media FROM mart.sm_monthly
  UNION ALL SELECT month, total_sm_spend, 'travel', travel FROM mart.sm_monthly
  UNION ALL SELECT month, total_sm_spend, 'software_tools', software_tools FROM mart.sm_monthly
  UNION ALL SELECT month, total_sm_spend, 'freelance', freelance FROM mart.sm_monthly
), s AS (
  SELECT rubro, month, v/NULLIF(tot,0) AS share,
         CASE WHEN month <= '2023-05' THEN 'hasta_may23' ELSE 'desde_jun23' END AS tramo
  FROM r
)
SELECT rubro, tramo, COUNT(*) AS meses,
  ROUND(MIN(share),4) AS share_min,
  ROUND(MAX(share),4) AS share_max,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ROUND(share,4)) AS valores_distintos_de_share,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(share*200 - ROUND(share*200)) < 0.0005 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS meses_share_multiplo_de_medio_punto
FROM s GROUP BY rubro, tramo ORDER BY rubro, tramo DESC

params.sql:
WITH sm AS (
  SELECT CAST(substr(month,1,4) AS INT) AS anio, month,
         total_sm_spend, enablement_spend, software_tools, freelance
  FROM mart.sm_monthly WHERE month >= '2022-03'
), alt AS (
  SELECT CAST(substr(month,1,4) AS INT) AS anio, SUM(new_customers) AS altas
  FROM mart.monthly_metrics WHERE month >= '2022-03' GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT sm.anio,
  ROUND(SUM(sm.total_sm_spend),3) AS sm_total,
  ROUND(SUM(sm.enablement_spend),3) AS habilitacion,
  ROUND(SUM(sm.software_tools),3) AS software_tools,
  ROUND(SUM(sm.freelance),3) AS freelance,
  ROUND(SUM(sm.enablement_spend)/SUM(sm.total_sm_spend),4) AS share_habilitacion,
  alt.altas,
  ROUND(SUM(sm.total_sm_spend)/alt.altas,4) AS sm_por_alta_con_habilitacion,
  ROUND((SUM(sm.total_sm_spend)-SUM(sm.enablement_spend))/alt.altas,4) AS sm_por_alta_sin_habilitacion
FROM sm JOIN alt ON alt.anio = sm.anio
GROUP BY sm.anio, alt.altas ORDER BY sm.anio
